column1: # Candidate OSS suites under evaluation -- read ONLY by bench-candidates.yml
# (parity_one.sh via OSS_MANIFEST). NOT in oss_suites.tsv, so the daily
# gate/table never touch them. Promote to oss_suites.tsv once a suite
#   phpstan-src -- ~493-test gap (rust 12093 vs vanilla 12586). The earlier
#                  "providers use Fibers / Cannot switch fibers" note was WRONG:
#                  a PHP-8.4 repro disproved every obvious cause. Confirmed at
#                  parity: discovery (3751 == 3751 methods, none missed) and
#                  providers, which run PHPStan's analyser, enumerate the exact
#                  vanilla row counts in isolation AND survive MethodPlanner's
#                  keyed merge). The residual is an execution-level divergence
#                  that only manifests in the faithful CI container; localizing
#                  it per-method needs a per-test reporter (JUnit/TAP) we don't
#                  have yet. Kept as a known-gap candidate, not gated.
